summary: Restore project deployment options and native JSON variable editing, and update filesystem matching dependencies to their patched releases.
userImpact: Pending engine access requests no longer prevent a project's active deployment targets from loading.
Mission Control displays native JSON content correctly and serializes JSON edits without losing their value type.

instructions: Upgrade the qualified host composition; existing access requests and grants need no data repair.

changes: Project engine access timestamps retain their existing numeric response contract.
Native Json variable values are returned as JSON values; scalar types and serialized Java Object values are preserved.

notes: Existing BIGINT columns are unchanged. Persistence converts their values to safe JavaScript integers and rejects precision loss.

security: Project and engine authorization, tenant filtering and deployment eligibility are unchanged.
Variable-value permissions and PII redaction still run on normalized values; malformed JSON returns a sanitized error.
Pin glob 14.0.2 and minimatch 11.0.1 in the application and frozen-bootstrap workspace closure for CVE-2026-118773 and CVE-2026-118764; no advisory suppression or severity changes.

customerDocumentation.reason: Restores existing deployment options without changing user configuration or administration procedures.

knownLimitations: Standalone npm consumers must reproduce the glob/minimatch root overrides and qualify their installed tree; pnpm workspace overrides are not propagated by published package manifests.
rollback: Revert to the previous qualified host composition. Persisted data is unchanged; the earlier timestamp validation failure can recur.
validation: 205 affected backend HTTP, schema, access, engine transport, variable visibility and history tests passed.
27 affected frontend variable-editor and project tests passed, including JSON object, array, string, boolean, number and null writes.
Five real PostgreSQL 16 persistence cases passed, including unsafe-integer rejection.
Real pinned Operaton 2.1.0 runtime, task, JSON read/edit and completed-history round trip passed on an emulated amd64 local fixture.
Shared, backend-host and frontend-host builds, backend typecheck, authorization structure, package-version discipline, ESLint, release-note preflight and documentation checks passed.
Protected exact-candidate database portability, browser and image qualification remain required before publication.
